senses.sense_definition: A painful, deep-seated skin infection consisting of a cluster of boils.

examples.text: The doctor prescribed antibiotics to treat the painful <w>carbuncle</w> on his neck.
A severe <w>carbuncle</w> requires medical attention to prevent the infection from spreading further.

senses.sense_definition: An ugly or unattractive building that ruins the appearance of its surroundings.

examples.text: The modern glass tower was widely criticized as a <w>carbuncle</w> on the historic city skyline.
Local residents campaigned to demolish the concrete <w>carbuncle</w> that dominated the town square.

senses.sense_definition: A deep-red precious stone, typically cut in a rounded, polished shape.

examples.text: The antique brooch featured a large, glowing <w>carbuncle</w> set in intricate gold filigree.
Ancient texts often describe the <w>carbuncle</w> as a stone that shines with an inner fire.

traits.comment: Refers to historical usage in literature or jewelry.

senses.sense_definition: A heraldic symbol consisting of eight radiating staves or sceptres.

examples.text: The family crest displayed a golden <w>carbuncle</w> against a deep blue background.
In medieval heraldry, the <w>carbuncle</w> was a common decorative charge on shields.
